mutations.name: a later reservation no longer yields to an earlier one
kills: which reservations a PR waits behind lets the earlier of two overlapping reservations go and holds the later one

mutations.name: the rule's ignore globs are not applied
kills: which paths two PRs overlap on never counts changeset files or generated files such as CAPABILITIES.md

mutations.name: a reservation never expires
kills: which reservations a PR waits behind stops waiting once the reservation is older than the TTL or its run no longer drives

mutations.name: a run let through first still waits behind the reservation
kills: which reservations a PR waits behind never waits behind a reservation that let it merge first

mutations.name: an expiry keeps its row, so every later read expires it again
mutations.find: "DELETE FROM shepherd_merge_order WHERE repo = ? AND run_id = ? AND since = ?"
mutations.replace: "UPDATE shepherd_merge_order SET reason = reason WHERE repo = ? AND run_id = ? AND since = ?"
kills: the merge-order store expires a reservation once: a second expiry of it ends nothing and logs nothing
